summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Communications Tab - Audience Segments and Settings functionality. All 34 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend testing verified: Audience Segments tab with segment cards, Segment Builder with rule editor and live preview, Settings tab with all configuration sections (Sender Config, Channel Controls, Quiet Hours, Privacy & Opt-Out, Tracking & Analytics).
critical_code_review_comments: All Audience Segments APIs properly implemented: GET list, GET single, POST create, PUT update, DELETE, POST preview, POST refresh, GET filter-fields, GET members
All Communication Settings APIs properly implemented: GET settings, PUT update, POST validate, GET quiet-hours, POST reset
Segment Builder has live preview that updates in real-time as rules are modified
Filter fields support: ticket_type, checkin_status, registration_status, registration_date, attendee_email, attendee_name
Operators support: equals, not_equals, contains, not_contains, in, not_in, greater_than, less_than, between, is_empty, is_not_empty
Settings sections: Sender Configuration, Channel Controls, Quiet Hours, Privacy & Opt-Out, Tracking & Analytics
data-testid attributes properly implemented: segments-tab, settings-tab, create-segment-btn, segment-name-input, save-segment-btn, save-settings-btn
seed_data_creation: Existing segments: 'Checked In Attendees' (id=1, 1 attendee), 'Not Checked In' (id=2, 0 attendees). Test segment 'TEST_UI_Segment_2' was created and deleted during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Communications Tab now has all 4 sub-tabs fully functional: All Campaigns, Templates, Audience Segments, Settings. Audience Segments APIs tested: GET /segments (list), GET /segments/filter-fields, POST /segments/preview, POST /segments (create), GET /segments/:id, PUT /segments/:id, DELETE /segments/:id, GET /segments/:id/members, POST /segments/:id/refresh. Communication Settings APIs tested: GET /communication-settings, PUT /communication-settings, POST /communication-settings/validate, GET /communication-settings/quiet-hours, POST /communication-settings/reset. Frontend displays: Segment cards with name, description, count, status, match type, rules count. Segment Builder with name, description, match type (ALL/ANY), filter rules with field/operator/value selectors, live preview panel showing matched attendees. Settings page with 5 sections: Sender Configuration (sender name, reply-to email, SMS sender ID), Channel Controls (email/SMS toggles), Quiet Hours (start/end time), Privacy & Opt-Out (opt-out toggle, unsubscribe URL), Tracking & Analytics (track opens/clicks toggles).

api_get_segments_list.details: GET /api/events/:eventId/segments returns list of segments with name, description, match_type, rules_json, estimated_count, is_active

api_get_filter_fields.details: GET /api/events/:eventId/segments/filter-fields returns 6 fields: ticket_type, checkin_status, registration_status, registration_date, attendee_email, attendee_name with operators

api_create_segment.details: POST /api/events/:eventId/segments creates segment with name, description, match_type, rules_json, is_active and calculates estimated_count

api_get_segment_by_id.details: GET /api/events/:eventId/segments/:segmentId returns single segment with all fields

api_update_segment.details: PUT /api/events/:eventId/segments/:segmentId updates segment fields and recalculates count

api_preview_segment.details: POST /api/events/:eventId/segments/preview returns matched members and total count based on rules

api_refresh_segment.details: POST /api/events/:eventId/segments/:segmentId/refresh recalculates count and updates last_evaluated_at

api_get_segment_members.details: GET /api/events/:eventId/segments/:segmentId/members returns paginated list of segment members

api_get_communication_settings.details: GET /api/events/:eventId/communication-settings returns settings with all fields, creates default if not exists

api_update_communication_settings.details: PUT /api/events/:eventId/communication-settings updates settings with validation for email format and time format

api_validate_settings.details: POST /api/events/:eventId/communication-settings/validate returns valid, errors, warnings for email/sms channel

api_get_quiet_hours_status.details: GET /api/events/:eventId/communication-settings/quiet-hours returns inQuietHours boolean and configured times

api_reset_settings.details: POST /api/events/:eventId/communication-settings/reset resets all settings to default values

frontend_audience_segments_tab.details: Audience Segments tab displays segment cards with icon, name, description, count, status badge, match type, rules count, and menu (Edit, Refresh Count, Delete)

frontend_segment_builder.details: Segment Builder has name input, description textarea, match type buttons (ALL/ANY), filter rules with field/operator/value selectors, Add Rule button, Active toggle, and live preview panel

frontend_segment_live_preview.details: Live preview shows matched attendees in real-time with name, ticket, status, email columns and total count badge

frontend_settings_tab.details: Settings tab displays 5 sections: Sender Configuration, Channel Controls, Quiet Hours, Privacy & Opt-Out, Tracking & Analytics with all form fields and toggles

frontend_create_segment_flow.details: Create segment flow works: fill form -> see live preview -> save -> success toast -> return to list with new segment

frontend_data_testid_attributes.details: All interactive elements have data-testid: segments-tab, settings-tab, create-segment-btn, segment-name-input, save-segment-btn, save-settings-btn, sender-name-input, reply-to-input, etc.

mocked_functionality.campaign_send: POST /api/events/:eventId/campaigns/:campaignId/send is MOCKED - marks campaign as sent and creates recipient records but doesn't actually send emails/SMS
